findings.title: Fallback locale files are not loaded for translations outside controller requests
findings.body: The translation accelerator only loads `config.locale` before calling the backend. `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` performs fallback lookups by invoking the backend directly for the fallback locale, so it does not re-enter `I18n.translate` and therefore does not load that locale's YAML file. The new `ApplicationController#set_locale` works around this only for controller actions; jobs, mailers, models, rake tasks, and any translation performed before that callback can fall back to an unloaded default/en locale and return missing-translation errors even when the fallback translation exists. Loading every locale in `I18n.fallbacks[config.locale]` as part of translation (or otherwise ensuring this globally) is needed.
